name: todo-list
description: A timeline for tracking completed works and releases

scripts.dev: rm -rf .dev && tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json && concurrently --no-color --kill-others-on-fail --names tsc,server "tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node scripts/dev.ts"
scripts.dev:bridge: rm -rf .dev && tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json && concurrently --no-color --kill-others-on-fail --names tsc,server "tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node scripts/dev.ts --bridge"
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.ts
scripts.test: node --test src/pages/works/catalog/model/catalog.test.ts src/pages/works/catalog/model/timeline.test.ts src/pages/works/catalog/model/transfer.test.ts src/pages/works/bridge/catalog.test.ts src/pages/works/bridge/router.test.ts src/pages/works/db/migrate.test.ts src/pages/travel/travel.test.ts src/pages/travel/map/map.test.ts scripts/catalog-bridge/server.test.ts scripts/bridge/travel.test.ts scripts/pages.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
